proof_body:
by
  intro f g a δ hδ hc hd hl hr
  have hnear : ∀ x ∈ Set.Ioo (a - δ) a, HasDerivAt f (g x) x := fun x hx =>
    hd x hx.2.ne (by rw [abs_lt]; constructor <;> linarith [hx.1, hx.2])
  have hnear' : ∀ x ∈ Set.Ioo a (a + δ), HasDerivAt f (g x) x := fun x hx =>
    hd x hx.1.ne' (by rw [abs_lt]; constructor <;> linarith [hx.1, hx.2])
  refine isLocalMin_of_deriv hc ?_ ?_ ?_
  · refine eventually_nhdsWithin_iff.mpr (Metric.eventually_nhds_iff.mpr ⟨δ, hδ, fun x hx hne => ?_⟩)
    exact (hd x hne (by rwa [Real.dist_eq] at hx)).differentiableAt
  · filter_upwards [Ioo_mem_nhdsLT (show a - δ < a by linarith)] with x hx
    rw [(hnear x hx).deriv]
    exact hl x hx
  · filter_upwards [Ioo_mem_nhdsGT (show a < a + δ by linarith)] with x hx
    rw [(hnear' x hx).deriv]
    exact hr x hx
target_source: ∀ (f g : ℝ → ℝ) (a δ : ℝ), 0 < δ → ContinuousAt f a → (∀ x, x ≠ a → |x - a| < δ → HasDerivAt f (g x) x) → (∀ x ∈ Set.Ioo (a - δ) a, g x ≤ 0) → (∀ x ∈ Set.Ioo a (a + δ), 0 ≤ g x) → IsLocalMin f a
